details.description: GPT-5.6 Sol is OpenAI's flagship reasoning model in the GPT-5.6 family, launched July 13, 2026. AWS Bedrock's model card describes it as delivering frontier reasoning and state-of-the-art agentic performance across coding, cybersecurity and scientific research. It takes text and image input and produces text output, with a knowledge cutoff of February 16, 2026 and reasoning effort adjustable from none up to max. Artificial Analysis's leaderboard marks it deprecated and recommends the newer GPT-6 Sol instead, though AWS Bedrock's model card lists its lifecycle as Active (EOL no sooner than July 2027) and OpenAI's own documentation does not list it among deprecated models.
advantages: AWS Bedrock's model card describes it as delivering frontier reasoning and state-of-the-art agentic performance across coding, cybersecurity, and scientific research.
Scores 47 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at max reasoning effort, ranked #19 of 210 comparable models and well above the comparable-model median of 25.
Supports reasoning effort levels from none to max, plus function calling, structured outputs, file search, web search, code interpreter, computer use and MCP tool use via the Responses API.
disadvantages: Output is text-only; the model does not generate images, audio or video.
Not compatible with Live sessions, Realtime, Assistants, fine-tuning, embeddings, or audio/video features.
Artificial Analysis's leaderboard marks this model deprecated, recommending the newer GPT-6 Sol instead.
use_cases: Complex reasoning chains and long document analysis
Agentic workflows using computer use, code interpreter and MCP tools

notes: Catalog facts give max_input_tokens as [922000, 1000000]; OpenAI's and AWS's own pages describe a 1,050,000-token context window (922,000 max input plus up to 128,000 output), which is consistent with that range across hosts, so no value was restated or flagged as a conflict. Artificial Analysis's own page for this model carries the banner 'This model is deprecated... OpenAI has launched a newer model, GPT-6 Sol (max). We suggest considering it instead.' -- verified verbatim from the page. AWS Bedrock's model card lists the model's lifecycle as 'Active' with EOL no sooner than July 13, 2027, and OpenAI's own deprecations page lists gpt-5.6-sol only as a recommended replacement for older models, never as deprecated itself, so the maker/host status is kept as active despite AA's deprecated badge. Could not open openai.com's own launch posts (previewing-gpt-5-6-sol, gpt-5-6) or the OpenAI Help Center article, which returned HTTP 403 on every fetch attempt; relied on OpenAI's API docs subdomain and AWS's model card instead.
